entries.title: A task moved to another project works in that project
entries.body: When your first mate moves a task that has not started to another project, the task now works there: its pull request and checks are in that project. Before, it kept working in the project it came from. A task moved before this update still works in its old project.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the moved task's pull request now opens in its new project.
